{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read revenue as string
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv', converters={'revenue': str})

# Strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Remove QA rows
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print supporting numbers
print(f'Number of loyal, completed orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Number after removing QA rows: {len(loyal_completed_clean)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')

mean_revenue"}
